references.source: hand-written implementation of spec #312 with tests, migration and backfill

mutants.wrong: Leaves the legacy invoice total (sum in major units, floored)
mutants.violates: R8: totalCents is exactly the sum of its lines' amountCents

mutants.wrong: Keeps the raw-SQL db.get lookup, so unknown and other orgs' entries answer 500
Requires approved time whatever the flag says
mutants.violates: R7: with the flag off, invoicing works exactly as today

mutants.wrong: Adds approved time to the v2 timesheet only
mutants.violates: R11: each row of the deprecated v1 timesheet gets approved_hours

mutants.wrong: Editing an entry keeps its approval
mutants.violates: R5: changing an approved or rejected entry puts it back to pending

mutants.wrong: Bulk approval approves the valid ids before reporting the bad one
mutants.violates: R6: all or nothing; then nothing changes

mutants.wrong: Backfills in the migration but not in the development seed
mutants.violates: R13: in existing databases and in the development seed

mutants.wrong: The rejection notification goes to the admin who rejected
mutants.violates: R10: notifies the person who logged the entry

mutants.wrong: A reason of only spaces is accepted
mutants.violates: R3: a missing or blank reason is a 400
